content.title: Faculty to join global expert group on teaching and learning
content.summary: Dr Jane Rarieya is the second AKU expert to advise Advance HE

media.alt: Faculty to join global expert group on teaching and learning

content.text: Dr Jane Rarieya, director of teaching and learning at AKU's Network of Quality, Teaching and Learning (QTL_net), has been appointed to Advance HE's Expert Advisory Group on Fellowship and Accreditation.

Advance HE works with higher education institutions around the world to promote excellence in teaching and learning. Dr Rarieya will help shape Advance HE body's policy and processes with a view of enhancing the professional development of all those who teach and support learning in the sector.

Dr Rarieya is the second AKU faculty member to provide guidance and expertise to Advance HE. In 2020, Professor Tashmin Khamis, vice-provost Quality, Teaching and Learning, was appointed to Advance HE's Global Perspectives Strategic Advisory Group which works in consultation with members to shape the future direction of the organisation.

In 2019, AKU became the first University in South Asia and East Africa to gain accreditation by Advance HE (UK). All universities in the UK are subscribers to Advance HE which has strategic partnerships with Higher Education Institutions in 23 other countries.
